body:
Prepare people for a defined change

Use this starter kit to review one initiative, identify the people affected and agree the preparation needed before the next decision. It brings role impacts, evidence, stakeholder actions and unresolved questions into a shared record.

Who it is for

Sponsors, programme leads, workflow owners and managers preparing an AI or digital change in a mid-sized or large organisation.

How to use it

Read the guide, copy the blank worksheets and review them with people who perform and support the work. The fictional examples show the level of detail; the prompts help challenge a draft without inventing facts or approving the change.

Your organisation owns communication, learning delivery, implementation and operation. For help applying the plan, explore AI and digital change management advisory.

All worked examples are fictional. The worksheets are planning records, not automatic readiness scores or evidence of client results.

The download includes a formatted Excel workbook and individual CSV copies. Each worksheet has a blank template and a clearly labelled fictional example. Prompts are supplied as plain text, and the HTML guide can be read or printed in a browser.

Turn readiness findings into a working plan

This pack helps sponsors, managers and programme teams connect a defined business change with role impacts, leadership decisions, practical communication, learning and evidence for the next rollout decision.

Who it is for

Leadership and transformation teams with internal or partner delivery capacity, preparing an AI initiative or a related digital change.

How to use it

Work through six linked records: change brief; stakeholder and role impacts; sponsor/manager plan; communications and enablement; adoption measures; and wave review. Use the paired fictional examples to understand the detail, then keep your own evidence, unknowns and decision owners visible.

The twelve prompts support review and drafting. Your organisation retains responsibility for approvals, employee communication, learning delivery, rollout and operation. Authentia can support the decisions through change-management advisory.

Read the public sample to see genuine excerpts and a usable prompt. All worked examples are fictional; completing a worksheet does not establish readiness or authorise deployment.

Connect the working decisions

This pack helps responsible teams establish a practical review process around specific AI uses. It connects an inventory with guidance, ownership, supplier evidence, oversight and a record of decisions and changes.

Who it is for

Business sponsors, AI programme leads and governance colleagues coordinating with their legal, privacy, security, risk, procurement and technical owners.

Work through six worksheet types with the guide and matching fictional examples. Carry a stable use identifier across records, preserve evidence references and distinguish draft proposals from actual authorised decisions.
